title: Studio OWD overview Save still publishes unpinned, so two admins saving the same object's sharing default, the later save silently overwrites the earlier
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6kDA9BVrMsBR9rmrJ

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the #36726 dev (os-dev-report comment 7129863132 on #36726), outside that card's surface; PR #36958 (that card) does not touch it. Pre-existing on main 53857591. Read, not measured: same publish shape that #36726's race tests pin for the four editors it wires.

## What happens
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx:487` publishes each saved object with `publishSavedItem(client, { type: 'object', name, packageId }, s.row.hasDraft)` and passes no `pinned` version. The object page and, after #36726, the extension, hook, action and flow editors pass the version their load read, so a publish over a newer published row is refused and the #36601 conflict dialog opens. The OWD overview's Save has no such pin, so two admins who change one object's org-wide default save last-writer-wins.

## Done when
- The OWD overview's load records each row's published version, and its Save passes it as `pinned`, the way #36726 wires the Studio editors (`DraftSaveGuard`, `recordPublished`, the `reloaded` outcome).
- A race pin: another writer publishes between the load and the Save, and the Save is refused with the #36601 dialog. Plus the unpinned control and one ablation.

reach: Studio OWD overview (public UI door), read from source; repro not measured.
Business reason: two admins setting sharing defaults at once lose one change with no warning; it is a security-relevant setting.
Reader: the o7-studio area of seat repo:objectstack#7.
Dedupe: `PackageOwdOverviewPanel publish` → 0; `unpinned publish` → 7, open: #36726 (parent, other editors), #36350 (view drafts, unrelated), the rest seat posts.
Suggested-grade: p2 · area:build · Bug · admins, rare (two concurrent saves of one object's OWD) · read.
